from build123d import *

outer_diameter = 40.0
inner_diameter = 20.0
length = 70.0
reduced_diameter = 30.0
reduced_length = 15.0
chamfer_size = 1.5
mount_hole_diameter = 4.0

outer_radius = outer_diameter / 2.0
inner_radius = inner_diameter / 2.0
reduced_radius = reduced_diameter / 2.0

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((0, 0), (outer_radius, 0))
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (outer_radius, 10))

            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (reduced_radius, 10 + reduced_length))
            l5 = Line(l4 @ 1, (outer_radius, 10 + reduced_length))
            l6 = Line(l5 @ 1, (outer_radius, length))
            l7 = Line(l6 @ 1, (0, length))
            l8 = Line(l7 @ 1, (0, 0))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Z)

solid_body = p.part
solid_body = solid_body - Pos(0, 0, length / 2) * Cylinder(inner_radius, length)
solid_body = solid_body - Pos(outer_radius, 0, length / 2) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(mount_hole_diameter / 2, outer_diameter)
